requirements_summary: Enterprise RAG/search platform for regulated financial docs. Index scale target: 100M-250M documents (embeddings). Primary workload: low-latency document ranking + reranking for search & SLA-driven chat assistants. Latency target: tail p99 <150ms, ideal p99/p95 for pure search queries <50ms in UK region. Throughput: peaks ~1200 qps with bursts. Cost sensitivity: target sub-$0.008 per query (embedding+rerank) at scale. Model preferences: open large embedding model (vector dims 1536) + rerank with distilled cross-encoder on dedicated GPUs; need runtime fallback to smaller models for burst scenarios. Routing/failover: multi-region read replicas (Ireland, London) with automatic failover and locality routing. Data residency: EU/UK data residency strict — logs, index shards, and backups must remain in-region. Security: SSO/SAML, audit logging, encrypted-at-rest with customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM), ISO27001 proof required.
